scope: Entire ordinary production scene and all authored bicycle/scooter docks. Only positively supported player observer fixtures are placed; physical KEY_E press/release dispatch and synthetic maintained W/Space actions drive actual retained bodies and original collisions/supports. No vehicle/actor/source transform fixtures, no direct mount calls. Native saved images require separate image review; engine events are not human OS-key, subjective comfort or performance acceptance.
startup_timing_scope: Single whole-scene test startup plus eight fixed ticks and input hashing on this Mac; not repeated load benchmark, frame-rate or another-Mac performance acceptance.
